sections.theory:
Hockey

Hockey is the national game of Pakistan. The following skills are included in it.

Stopping the ball (Stopping)

Hitting (Hitting)

Dribbling (Dribbling)

Scoop (Scoping)

Biomechanical principles in hockey skills:

Stopping the ball

Keeping the balance of the body, keep the hockey stick in the direction of the ball. According to the direction and speed of the ball keep the hockey stick on the ground; when the ball strikes the hockey stick, let the stick come back a little so that the force of a powerful hit can be reduced. As a result of the striking of the hockey stick Newton’s third law applies. If the hockey stick is not taken back a little, then as a reaction the ball will roll far away in the opposite direction and will go out of the reach of the player.

Dribbling

Keeping the ball in one’s possession, dodging other players and moving to attack the opposing team is called dribbling. While dribbling, the player, bending his waist, keeps the ball near his body so that the players of the other team cannot snatch the ball easily. In this skill the laws of motion and the conditions of balance apply.

Hitting
